decisions.reason: Ending the production engagement does not revise or delete any preview-duration, language, content, or approval-purpose attribute through a valid propagated MODIFY.

The source does not modify or retract the mobile-optimized subtitle standard.
The engagement termination does not alter the required realistic, native-looking UGC visual style or its realism criteria.
The source does not resolve or modify the audio-level standard, requested dB value, mix standard, or existing ambiguity.
The task termination does not revise the required keywords, prohibited terms, source references, or wording constraints.
